prompt: A theater with actors and crew. An actor is rehearsing on stage while holding a script and wearing a costume. A director is sitting in the audience, taking notes while pointing at the actor. The lead actor on stage appears older and more experienced than the lighting technician. A lighting technician is adjusting spotlights from a control booth positioned above the audience. The control booth contains a panel with a number of switches, and their number is two more than the number of the actor's costume pieces. A makeup artist is applying makeup to another actor in the dressing room using brushes. The makeup artist is standing behind the actor who is sitting in front of a mirror. A stagehand is moving props across the stage while wearing work gloves. The props include a table and four chairs positioned around it. A wardrobe assistant is hanging costumes on a rack backstage. The rack has four wheels. Next to it is a cart with a number of hats, which is half the number of wheels on the rack.
